Definition: an enclitic indefinite pronoun; some or any person or object:--a (kind of), any (man, thing, thing at all), certain (thing), divers, he (every) man, one (X thing), ought, + partly, some (man, -body, - thing, -what), (+ that no-)thing, what(-soever), X wherewith, whom(-soever), whose(-soever).
BiblicalUsage: This little word means some, any, a certain one — the indefinite somebody the storytellers lean on. Jesus says neither does any man know the Father save the Son, and then He opens two stories with the same word: a certain man went down to Jericho, and a certain man was sick, named Lazarus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the doorway into the parables and the miracles is this little word: some man, any man, a certain man — and then the story turns on him.
